description: Keyword search over the downloadable federal geodata collections on data.geo.admin.ch (STAC): swisstopo elevation/imagery/maps, BAFU/BFE/ARE datasets and MeteoSwiss open data, e.g. 'ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-smn' (SwissMetNet automatic weather stations), 'ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-nime' (manual precipitation), 'ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-pollen'. Returns collection ids, titles, licence, providers and time extent. Next: get_geodata_collection_items. Examples: query='meteoschweiz', 'swissalti3d', 'Lärm'. Omit query to page through all collections.

query.description: Keywords matched against id, title, description, keywords and providers (all must match)

name: search_geodata_collections
title: Search the geo.admin.ch STAC data catalogue
